start.speaker: yev
start.text: You built a room with a door in a place that used to have neither. My grove had no doors. I am learning what they are for. Tonight I think they are for saying that the Rootched have taken cuttings from my grove and I do not know what they are growing.

choices.text: Then we find out. Together, with the door shut.
Whatever they grow, it does not get to grow through you.

together.speaker: yev
together.text: Together. That is a door I can walk through.

promise.speaker: yev
promise.text: You cannot promise that. Thank you for promising it.
